WITH rating_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) as avg_per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_price) as overall_avg
  FROM rating_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(rs.avg_per_day_price) as avg_per_day_price,
  AVG(rs.avg_per_day_price) - oav.overall_avg as how_far_above
FROM rating_stats rs, overall_avg_value oav
WHERE rs.avg_per_day_price > oav.overall_avg
